verdict.rationale: Qodo is a SaaS code-review platform, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for it, and the axis applies. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404, and no documentation mentions a machine-readable API spec. The MCP server, CLI and llms.txt are separate features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
